Standard Meters:

Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGM):
Advanced sensor systems like Freestyle Libre and Dexcom options range from 4,000 INR to 8,000 INR per box/unit via medical distributors.

Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
Smart Wristwatches:
Digital touch smartwatches with basic heart rate, blood pressure, and sleep monitoring features start around 260 INR to 975 INR for bulk/individual orders.
Tradeindia
Remote ECG Devices:
Portable wireless patch monitors and 3-lead or 12-channel Holter systems range from 9,000 INR for basic mobile-app-linked units up to 45,000 INR for clinical multi-channel diagnostic equipment.

Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
Multipara Monitors:
Standard hospital and clinic multi-parameter bedside monitors span 12,000 INR to 65,000 INR based on display size and parameters tracked (SpO2, ECG, NIBP, RESP).

Cardiac Telemetry:
Long-range home cardiac telemetry systems support multi-patient tracking with wireless data integration for remote clinical evaluation.
